$comment: Classification of SQL migration artifacts that knexfile.ts (extension: 'ts') does not execute. Production preflight fails when a .sql file in this directory is missing here, so no migration artifact is silently ignored. See docs/ongoing-projects/ongoing.md, DB-07 and DB-08.

005_create_accounts_table.sql.note: Creates the MUD-owned `accounts` table. Schema ownership belongs to the MUD bootstrap, so this must never be replayed from DurisWeb.

006_create_forum_tables.sql.note: Sole definition of forum_categories, forum_threads, forum_posts, forum_reactions, forum_subscriptions, forum_notifications, and web_sessions. No TypeScript migration creates them, so Knex history is not replayable from empty until the DB-07 baseline exists.

007_add_dynamic_permissions.sql.note: Sole definition of forum_settings and forum_permission_audit, plus forum_categories permission columns.

009_create_subscriptions.sql.note: Sole definition of forum_subscriptions and forum_notifications; partially reshaped later by 20251229000000_unified_notifications.ts.

011_create_user_profiles.sql.note: Sole definition of user_profiles and user_profile_stats, both required by production preflight.

013_create_forum_polls.sql.note: Sole definition of forum_polls, forum_poll_options, forum_poll_votes, and forum_poll_vote_history.

014_category_management.sql.note: Sole definition of forum_category_permissions plus forum_categories management columns.

015_add_ip_tracking.sql.note: Adds IP tracking columns to forum_threads and forum_posts.

017_fix_emoji_icons.sql.note: One-off UPDATE of forum_categories icon values. Not schema; retained as documentation of the applied repair.

018_add_admin_action_log.sql.note: Sole definition of admin_action_log; later altered by 20251116130000_expand_admin_action_log_types.ts.

019_create_wipe_history.sql.note: Sole definition of wipe_history; later altered by 20251113175859_add_excluded_players_to_wipe_history.ts.
